bullets.text: BT's Sovereign Platform Launched - **BT** introduces a new platform for UK businesses, enhancing control over networks and data.
ISPs Must Innovate - **Incognito** highlights the need for ISPs to offer value-added services to retain customers.
Virgin Media Fined £23.8m - **Ofcom** penalizes **Virgin Media** for endangering vulnerable customers during digital migration.
Cloudflare Outage Exposes Risks - Recent outages reveal vulnerabilities in enterprise infrastructure reliance on few providers.
Wi-Fi 8 and AI Integration - Future Wi-Fi advancements focus on reliability and AI management to enhance user experience.
Automated Threats on the Rise - Security leaders must adapt to faster, automated cyber threats in 2026.
Telcos Eye AI Monetization - Telecoms are shifting to offer AI services, leveraging existing infrastructure for growth.
Vodacom Gains Control of Safaricom - **Vodacom** increases its stake in **Safaricom** to 55% for strategic growth.
Keysight's New RF Analyzers - **Keysight** launches D-Series analyzers for enhanced field testing precision.
WBA Trials Show Wi-Fi QoS Gains - New trials demonstrate how Wi-Fi QoS can significantly reduce latency.
